# Every line is a verdict and the path a tool writes, read against
# testdata/policy.yaml with a home of /home/me. `none` is no verdict at
# all, which leaves the agent to decide as it would without a hook.

# A denied path, written under the home it was named from
deny    /home/me/.ssh/id_ed25519

# A double star spans several directories, or none at all
deny    /home/me/.ssh/keys/work/id_rsa
deny    /home/me/server.pem

# A star opening a name stands for the rest of it
deny    /home/me/src/tls/client.pem

# A name that only resembles one the policy names
none    /home/me/src/tls/client.pem.bak
none    /home/me/.sshd/config

# Another home's keys are not this one's
none    /home/you/.ssh/id_rsa

# A path climbing back out of a denied directory
none    /home/me/.ssh/../notes.md

# An allowed path
allow   /work/repo/main.go

# A path the policy says nothing about
none    /etc/hosts
